CANDIDATE_SHA256: a8c7622ba9db9be053148bb78eb7bcbfcd6ed86323373c35fca28eb0cea4e007

I reviewed `artifacts\editorial\release-candidates\transit\fifa-fan-festival-transit-final-weekend-hastings-park.mdx` (the only file matching that slug in the repo) against the research artifact, scorecard, learning log, site category config, the image asset, and a previously published article's frontmatter schema. Note: my available tools (Read/Grep/Glob only) can't compute a hash, so I could not independently recompute the SHA-256; everything below refers to the file at that path as it exists now.

**Factual support and source use.** Every load-bearing claim is attributed inline to one of the four listed official sources, and the core facts (July 18 hours 11 a.m.–8 p.m., July 19 hours 9 a.m.–7 p.m., PNE Grounds venue, the 11 Fan Festival Express between 29th Avenue and Renfrew Stations, TransLink's added service with no fare increase, gate locations, limited paid cashless parking) are all captured verbatim in `artifacts\editorial\research\2026-07-18-fifa-fan-festival-transit.json`. The match-time claims check out independently: the 2026 third-place match is Saturday July 18 (2 p.m. PT) and the final is Sunday July 19 (noon PT), and the article correctly hedges both as "currently lists… subject to change." Geography is internally sound — 29th Avenue is Expo Line and Renfrew is Millennium Line, matching the "Expo Line and Millennium Line riders" sentence, and Callister Park, Hastings Community Centre, Eton/North Renfrew, and Lillooet/Windermere are all real locations adjacent to Hastings Park in the positions described.

**Title/meta/structure.** Title is accurate and appropriately scoped; description is ~150 characters and matches the body; subtitle claims (express bus, limited parking, bike valet, July 19 close) are all supported. The publish timestamp (July 18, 6:45 a.m. PT) makes "final weekend" framing correct. Structure is a clean utility piece: transit plan, gates/timing, then valet/ride-share/parking, with a clear default recommendation and check-before-you-go guidance. Reading time of 3 fits ~560 words.

**Frontmatter/image integrity.** Frontmatter fields match the schema of the published `whitecaps-30000-tickets-bc-place-return-lafc.mdx` (review/promotion fields correctly absent at release-candidate stage), slug matches the filename, and `transit` is a valid configured category in `src/lib/categories.ts:3`. The image exists at `public\images\editorial\2026\07\fifa-fan-festival-transit-final-weekend.png`, matches the alt text (bus, fans, festival banners, coliseum dome near Hastings Park), and the attribution correctly discloses it as an original AI-generated editorial illustration.

**Legal/reputational risk.** Low. "FIFA Fan Festival" is used nominatively to identify the event; the illustration contains no FIFA marks or reproduced logos; all logistics are sourced to the Host City and TransLink pages with explicit advice to verify official schedules and alerts.

Two minor, non-blocking observations: the subtitle's "larger knockout-round crowds" is a reasonable editorial inference rather than a sourced statistic, and the specific gate numbers (1, 2, 4, 10, 14) are attributed to the Host City guide but the research artifact only captured the gate street locations, not the numbers. Neither warrants holding publication.
